blocks.content: Welcome to Part 2 of the Science DEO Bank! This section covers True/False, Fill in the blanks, and Subjective questions.

blocks.title: Short Answer (Q80)
blocks.content:
**Question:** …………. is not an olfactory indicator for testing acids and bases. (anilla essence, Onions, Phenolphthalein)

**Answer:** Phenolphthalein

blocks.content:

blocks.title: Short Answer (Q83)
blocks.content:

blocks.content:
